title: Chat threads: whole thread to the model up to 64 KB, then a logged summary; auto-title (0.6.13, T21 PR 2)
head: t21-chat-context
body:
## Summary
- the model gets the whole thread (only that thread) until it passes 64 KB, then the oldest turns are summarized until it is under 32 KB, measured in UTF-8 bytes (decision #72)
- summarized turns stay in the thread file, the summary is its own drawer file (chats/<id>.summary.json), deleted with the thread
- every summary is logged with no message text, and a failed summary still gets a reply using the newest turns that fit
- auto-title: one call after the first reply, given only the first exchange as data, never for a renamed thread, logged
- summaries and titles use the profile's `small` route if defined, else `default`
- WS/REST shapes unchanged

## Note for review
- the summary is appended to the system message under a label saying it is data, not instructions (the worker kept the existing single-system-message shape) rather than sent as a separate message

## Tests
- summary kicks in at the budget (ticket test)
- no re-summarize under budget
- summary survives restart
- title only first exchange
- chat model never sees another thread's text
- coordinator mutation checks: raising the budget, raising the target, titling every turn, titling renamed threads, and leaking another thread's text into the title each fail a test
